profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website describes the company as focused on self-driving freight, using a system called the Aurora Driver. The site says the Aurora Driver is built with hardware and software backed by verifiable AI and is intended to integrate autonomy into trucking fleets.

The site presents the Aurora Driver as a self-driving system for freight hauling. It includes statements attributed to partners about a pilot program hauling freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, a hybrid model with Werner professional drivers, and integration with the Volvo VNL Autonomous. One quoted statement says freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050, making autonomous transport a necessity.

SEC records list the company under CIK 0001828108 as a for-profit public company. Pennsylvania records list 155 entries involving Aurora Innovation, Inc.
